name: Lunora
tagline: 自由组合玻璃信息胶囊、Duo 状态环与 mini Dock，打造完整状态栏体验。
description: iPhoneDuoIcon 正式更名为 Lunora · 月珞，带来全新图标与更完整的状态栏体验，升级会保留现有配置。
左侧玻璃信息胶囊与右侧 Duo 或 mini Dock 可独立设置并自由组合，显示时间日期、天气、媒体、音量、通知和 App 等内容。
提供灵活布局、独立配色、精确数值输入、天气响应优化和 Discord 反馈入口。
notice: 从 iPhoneDuoIcon 升级会保留现有配置。与 SingleVPN 冲突；更新后请重新加载 SpringBoard。
features: 左侧信息胶囊与右侧 Duo 或 mini Dock 独立配置、自由组合
分区玻璃、圆形分区和一体玻璃三种信息胶囊样式
时间日期、天气、媒体、音量和通知等胶囊模块，支持左右滑动切换常驻模块
mini Dock 支持固定或最近使用 App、应用搜索和拖动排序
mini Dock 可与星环共存，支持独立位置调整并在星环展开时自动避让
通知 App 图标、内容滚动、点击跳转及从灵动岛或刘海区域展开的横幅动画
支持隐藏系统音量条
胶囊水平加长及 AM/PM 同行、上方或下方排列
优化小屏、锁屏和通知中心布局，并正确应用强制 12/24 小时设置
独立边框、模块图标与 VPN 指示颜色设置
点按滑杆数值可手动输入精确参数
天气与定位后台响应，保留缓存与刷新限频以减少界面卡顿
设置主页提供 Discord BUG 反馈与建议入口
简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置界面
usage: 安装时确认移除存在冲突的 SingleVPN；升级自 iPhoneDuoIcon 会保留原有配置。
进入“设置 → Lunora”分别配置左侧信息胶囊与右侧 Duo 或 mini Dock。
选择胶囊玻璃样式与常驻模块，横向滑动可切换当前模块。
在 mini Dock 中选择固定或最近使用 App，并可搜索、排序和调整位置。
按需调整布局、配色与精确数值；设置修改即时生效。
需要帮助时可通过设置主页的 Discord 入口反馈 BUG 或提出建议。

changes: iPhoneDuoIcon 正式更名为 Lunora · 月珞，升级保留现有配置；左侧信息胶囊与右侧 Duo／mini Dock 可独立组合。
新增多种玻璃信息胶囊、mini Dock、通知与音量模块，支持常驻模块切换、App 搜索排序及通知交互动画。
扩展布局、配色与精确数值设置，优化小屏/锁屏、12/24 小时和天气响应，并新增 Discord 反馈入口。
新增独立 VPN 图标隐藏开关，与 VPN 着色分开控制，并改善系统 VPN 显示兼容性。
自定义配色可自动适应深浅背景；充电时可选用系统电池颜色，拔电后恢复自定义颜色。
胶囊左侧新增可预览、校验格式的日期，并优化日期排版、动画及与其他插件共用时的显示。
新增沿电池轮廓循环的充电流光，高亮头部搭配渐隐拖尾。
充电流光支持自定义电池颜色，并保留真实电量比例与数字缺口。
优化动画流畅度，修复可能遮挡其他状态栏图标的问题。
星环与胶囊新增独立隐藏 AM/PM 开关，仅在 12 小时制下生效；24 小时制时自动禁用。
优化 Wi-Fi、电量轮廓、信号点线和顶部电量数字，并为胶囊顶部数字新增独立缩放与重置。
调整动画节奏：星环展开/合拢约 3 秒，胶囊约 4 秒，原生图标继续停留 3 秒。
新增独立配色：电池、Wi-Fi、5G/LTE、卡 1/卡 2 信号可分别设色并同步动画；启用后不再被系统状态颜色覆盖。
星环与胶囊均支持独立大小、水平/垂直位置调节，默认居中并支持一键重置。
新增颜色重置为默认绿色，并优化星环顶部电量数字缩放、宽度与圆弧间距。
新增星环整体大小、水平/垂直偏移与顶部电量独立缩放，默认保持居中。
星环与胶囊专属设置仅按当前样式显示，所有调整即时生效。
优化百分比数字宽度并减少对其他状态栏图标的影响；VPN 与定位兼容性仍需实机复测。
新增共用电量百分比开关，同时控制星环和胶囊；星环支持左侧或顶部缺口位置。
胶囊数字固定顶部，关闭数字时自动补齐轮廓，并隐藏不适用的位置选项。
设置修改即时生效，并兼容旧版开关保存值。
优化展开后原生电池的电量同步，修复偶发显示红色 1% 或缺失电量的问题。
展开交接时及时刷新电池状态，同时保持真实低电量、充电及低电量模式的正确显示。
新增星环左侧电量百分比开关，默认关闭、即时生效，字体跟随系统样式。
重做电池、信号与 Wi-Fi 展开动画，加入边界绕行、错峰曲线与轻微回弹，并保留双卡独立信号和 3 秒停留。
优化小屏胶囊显示与自动刘海避让，空间不足时等比缩小，空间充足时保持原尺寸。
新增自动刘海避让，根据状态栏可用空间调整胶囊大小；空间不足时等比缩小。
优化小屏设备的右侧定位、时间基线、点击区域与展开动画，避免内容被刘海遮挡。
保留右侧留白调节，并更新简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置说明。
新增“星环 / 胶囊”样式；胶囊整合时间、电量百分比与网络状态，并支持双卡独立分段信号。
优化单卡电量轮廓、时间字号与基线、Wi-Fi / 5G 间距，并修复 iOS 16 胶囊显示问题。
设置修改即时生效，新增手动重新加载 SpringBoard 与 0–20 pt 右侧留白调节。
新增 iOS 16 适配。
新增点击展开：组合图标可动画展开系统原生的蜂窝信号、Wi-Fi 和电池图标，3 秒后自动合拢。
优化原生图标的位置与尺寸衔接，减少动画结束时的跳动和生硬切换。
支持再次点击延长停留，并改善动画中断体验及三语言操作提示。
新增电量、Wi-Fi 与蜂窝信号三合一圆形状态栏图标。
支持单卡 4 点与双卡左右独立信号显示，并提供 VPN、充电及低电量模式状态提示。
新增启用开关、圆角设置图标，以及简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置。

en.name: Lunora
en.tagline: Freely combine a glass information capsule, Duo status ring, and mini Dock for a complete status bar experience.
description: iPhoneDuoIcon is now Lunora, with a new icon and a more complete status bar experience. Existing settings are preserved during the upgrade.
Configure the left glass information capsule separately from the right Duo or mini Dock, combining time and date, weather, media, volume, notifications, apps, and more.
Lunora also provides flexible layouts, independent colors, exact numeric input, improved weather responsiveness, and a Discord feedback entry.
en.notice: Upgrading from iPhoneDuoIcon preserves existing settings. Conflicts with SingleVPN; respring after updating.
features: Independent left information capsule and right Duo or mini Dock configurations
Split Glass, Circular Partition, and Continuous Glass capsule styles
Time and date, weather, media, volume, notification, and other capsule modules with horizontal resting-module switching
mini Dock with pinned or recent apps, app search, and drag reordering
Use mini Dock alongside Orbit with independent positioning and automatic avoidance during Orbit expansion
Notification app icons, scrolling content, tap-to-open actions, and banners expanding from the Dynamic Island or notch
Option to hide the system volume HUD
Extended capsule width and inline, above, or below AM/PM placement
Improved compact, Lock Screen, and Notification Center layouts with correct forced 12/24-hour behavior
Independent border, module-icon, and VPN-indicator colors
Tap slider values to enter exact numbers
Responsive background weather and location work with cached data and refresh limits
Discord entry for bug reports and suggestions
Settings in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Confirm removal of the conflicting SingleVPN package during installation; upgrading from iPhoneDuoIcon preserves existing settings.
Open Settings → Lunora to configure the left information capsule separately from the right Duo or mini Dock.
Choose a capsule glass style and resting module; swipe horizontally to switch the active module.
Choose pinned or recent apps in mini Dock, then search, reorder, and position them as needed.
Adjust layouts, colors, and exact values as desired; settings changes apply immediately.
Use the Discord entry on the main Settings page for bug reports or suggestions.

changes: iPhoneDuoIcon is now Lunora, preserving existing settings while allowing independent combinations of the left information capsule and right Duo or mini Dock.
Added multiple glass information capsule styles, mini Dock, notification and volume modules, resting-module switching, app search and sorting, and interactive notification animations.
Expanded layouts, colors, and exact numeric controls; improved compact and Lock Screen layouts, 12/24-hour handling, and weather responsiveness; and added Discord feedback.
Added a separate VPN icon hiding switch, independent of VPN coloring, and improved compatibility with the system VPN indicator.
Custom colors can adapt to light and dark backgrounds; optionally use the system battery color while charging and restore the custom color after unplugging.
Added a custom-formatted date to the left of Capsule with preview and validation, and improved date layout, animation, and display alongside other tweaks.
Added a looping charging highlight around the battery outline, with a bright head and fading trail.
The charging highlight supports custom battery colors while preserving the real charge level and percentage gap.
Improved animation smoothness and fixed an issue that could obscure other status bar icons.
Added independent Hide AM/PM switches for Orbit and Capsule, active only in 12-hour time and automatically disabled in 24-hour time.
Improved Wi-Fi, battery outlines, signal dots and lines, and top battery numbers, with independent scaling and reset for the Capsule top number.
Adjusted animation timing: Orbit unfolds and combines in about three seconds, Capsule in about four seconds, while native icons remain visible for three seconds.
Added independent colors for battery, Wi-Fi, 5G/LTE, SIM 1, and SIM 2 signals, synchronized with animations and protected from system status color overrides.
Orbit and Capsule now have independent size, horizontal, and vertical position controls, centered by default with one-tap reset.
Added color reset to the default green and improved top Orbit battery percentage scaling, digit width, and arc spacing.
Added Orbit size, horizontal and vertical offsets, centered by default, plus independent scaling for the top battery percentage.
Orbit- and Capsule-specific settings now appear only for the selected style, with all adjustments applied immediately.
Improved percentage digit width and reduced interference with other status bar icons; VPN and location compatibility still require device retesting.
Added a shared battery percentage switch for Orbit and Capsule; Orbit supports left-side or top-gap placement.
Capsule keeps the percentage at the top, completes its outline when numbers are hidden, and removes the unnecessary position option.
Settings changes apply immediately and remain compatible with values saved by earlier versions.
Improved native battery level synchronization after unfolding, fixing occasional red 1% or missing battery readings.
Battery status now refreshes during the unfold handoff while preserving accurate low-battery, charging, and Low Power Mode indicators.
Added an optional battery percentage to the left of Orbit, off by default and applied immediately with the system battery percentage font.
Redesigned battery, cellular, and Wi-Fi unfold animations with boundary-following motion, staggered curves, and subtle bounce, while retaining independent dual-SIM signals and the three-second hold.
Improved Capsule display and automatic notch avoidance on smaller screens, scaling proportionally when space is limited while preserving full size when space allows.
Added automatic notch avoidance that adjusts Capsule size to available status bar space and scales proportionally when space is limited.
Improved right-side positioning, the time baseline, tap area, and unfold animation on smaller screens to prevent content from being obscured by the notch.
Retained right-side spacing controls and updated the English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese settings descriptions.
Added Orbit and Capsule styles; Capsule combines time, battery percentage, and network status with independent segmented dual-SIM indicators.
Improved the single-line battery outline, time sizing and baseline, and Wi-Fi / 5G spacing, and fixed Capsule display on iOS 16.
Settings changes now apply immediately, with a manual Reload SpringBoard action and adjustable 0–20 pt right-side spacing.
Added support for iOS 16.
Tap the combined icon to reveal the system's native cellular, Wi-Fi, and battery icons; they automatically combine again after three seconds.
Improved native icon position and size alignment, reducing jumps and abrupt switching at the end of the animation.
Tap again to extend the hold, with smoother interrupted transitions and localized interaction hints in three languages.
Added a circular status bar icon that combines battery, Wi-Fi, and cellular status.
Added four-dot single-line and independent dual-SIM signal indicators, with VPN, charging, and Low Power Mode status.
Added an enable switch, a rounded Settings icon, and settings in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
